title: A startup says the AI bottleneck isn’t compute. It’s memory, and it ditched the GPU to prove it.
excerpt: Majestic Labs’ Prometheus server drops the GPU for Arm cores and up to 128TB of cheap LPDDR6, claiming to beat Nvidia’s memory bottleneck.
content_html:
The AI hardware conversation is stuck on one word: compute. A startup out of Tel Aviv wants to change the word to memory. Majestic Labs, founded in 2023 by former Google and Meta engineers, has unveiled a server it says can do the work of a rack of Nvidia GPUs. It does so by attacking a different bottleneck.

The pitch, reported by TechRadar, is that pairing pricey GPUs with scarce high-bandwidth memory has become a dead end for AI inference. Running a model is often limited by how much fast memory you can reach, not raw compute. So Majestic ditched the GPU.

Its server, Prometheus, swaps graphics chips for what it calls Ignite AI Processing Units. Each unit blends Arm cores with RISC-V vector and tensor engines. Up to 12 sit in one server, sharing a single pool of 8TB to 128TB of LPDDR6. That is the cheap memory found in phones, not the costly high-bandwidth memory that GPUs depend on.

A different way to hit the memory wall

The trick is the wiring. Instead of bolting memory onto each GPU package, Majestic pools it through custom aggregation chiplets. Copper cables up to a metre long connect them. The result, it claims, is one coherent pool far larger than a GPU box can address.

The comparison it reaches for is stark. An Nvidia DGX B300 with eight Blackwell GPUs carries 2.3TB of high-bandwidth memory. Majestic says Prometheus offers more than 50 times as much fast memory, at 1.7 times the interconnect bandwidth. One rack, it claims, matches 25 of Nvidia’s Vera Rubin racks for fast memory, at a fraction of the power.

The software story is friendlier than the hardware sounds. Prometheus is built to open standards and supports PyTorch, vLLM and OpenAI’s Triton. Models built for GPUs are meant to run on it without changes. Majestic says it has already taken orders from large enterprises, neoclouds and hyperscalers.

Striking numbers, no shipped hardware

Every figure here carries the same asterisk. It is Majestic’s own, ahead of independent testing, and nothing has shipped. The company has about 40 staff across Tel Aviv and Los Angeles. It raised $100m late last year, a modest sum against what its rivals command.

There are physical questions too. A 128TB pool built from 2GB LPDDR6 dies would need roughly 64,000 of them. That implies more than a hundred aggregation chiplets in a single server. It is a lot of parts to keep coherent, and TechRadar notes buyers will likely wait for independent benchmarks before switching.

What Majestic joins is a growing line of startups attacking Nvidia from odd angles. Optical chips, edge silicon for inference and open networking gear each pick a different weak point. The common thread is that Nvidia’s dominance is now a target from several sides at once, even its software moat.

The memory-wall pitch is the newest of them. It is also the least proven. Majestic has drawn a picture of a rack that shames a room of GPUs on memory and power. Next year, when hardware ships and someone else runs the benchmarks, the picture either holds or it does not.

content_html_zh:
人工智能硬件的对话停留在一个词上：计算。 特拉维夫的一家初创公司希望将这个词变成记忆。 Majestic Labs 由前 Google 和 Meta 工程师于 2023 年创立，推出了一款服务器，据称可以完成 Nvidia GPU 机架的工作。 它通过攻击不同的瓶颈来实现这一点。

据 TechRadar 报道，这种说法是，将昂贵的 GPU 与稀缺的高带宽内存配对已经成为人工智能推理的死胡同。 运行模型通常受到可以达到的快速内存速度的限制，而不是原始计算的限制。 所以 Majestic 放弃了 GPU。

它的服务器 Prometheus 将图形芯片替换为所谓的 Ignite AI 处理单元。 每个单元都将 Arm 内核与 RISC-V 矢量和张量引擎相结合。 一台服务器中最多可容纳 12 个服务器，共享一个 8TB 至 128TB LPDDR6 池。 这是手机中的廉价内存，而不是 GPU 所依赖的昂贵的高带宽内存。

打破记忆墙的另一种方式

诀窍在于接线。 Majestic 没有将内存固定到每个 GPU 包上，而是通过自定义聚合小芯片将内存池化。 连接它们的铜缆长达一米。 它声称，其结果是一个远大于 GPU 盒可以处理的一致池。

它所达到的比较是鲜明的。 配备 8 个 Blackwell GPU 的 Nvidia DGX B300 配备 2.3TB 高带宽内存。 Majestic 表示，Prometheus 提供的内存速度是原来的 50 倍以上，互连带宽是原来的 1.7 倍。 据称，一个机架可与 Nvidia 的 25 个 Vera Rubin 机架相匹配，以实现快速内存，而功耗仅为其一小部分。

软件的故事比硬件听起来更友好。 Prometheus 按照开放标准构建，支持 PyTorch、vLLM 和 OpenAI 的 Triton。 为 GPU 构建的模型无需更改即可在其上运行。 Majestic 表示，它已经收到了大型企业、新云和超大规模企业的订单。

惊人的数字，没有附带硬件

这里的每个数字都带有相同的星号。 它是 Majestic 自己的产品，在独立测试之前，尚未发货。 该公司在特拉维夫和洛杉矶拥有约 40 名员工。 去年年底，该公司筹集了 1 亿美元资金，相对于其竞争对手来说，这个数额不算大。

还有身体方面的问题。 由 2GB LPDDR6 芯片构建的 128TB 池大约需要 64,000 个。 这意味着单个服务器中有一百多个聚合小芯片。 TechRadar 指出，有很多部分需要保持一致，买家可能会等待独立基准测试后再进行转换。

Majestic 加入的是越来越多的初创公司从奇怪的角度攻击 Nvidia。 光学芯片、推理边缘芯片和开放网络设备各自都有不同的弱点。 共同点是，英伟达的主导地位现在同时成为多方攻击的目标，甚至包括其软件护城河。

记忆墙间距是其中最新的。 这也是最少被证实的。 Majestic 绘制了一张机架图，其内存和功耗足以让一室 GPU 相形见绌。 明年，当硬件发货并且其他人运行基准测试时，情况要么成立，要么不成立。
